status: STUDY / NONCANON: PROTOTYPE support assemblies over the unchanged vehicle

loads.note: design = structural proof load 29.42 MN / 4 (DERIVED, not flight thrust); equal share between nozzles

yoke_straps.note: upper bound: the force split between coil stations is OPEN; whatever coils 0-2 carry crosses these straps

cold_mass_supports.basis: G-10 class supports at 200 MPa working, conductivity integral 150 W/m (20-300 K), coil 20 K, cooler 15% of Carnot; support term only (nuclear, radiative and plasma loads on the coils OPEN)

cryostat.note: the 0.05 m warm-yoke standoff leaves 0.015 m outside a minimal cryostat: room for direct supports only. The built strike modules (coils 2-3) sit on the coil inner face, i.e. inside where the cryostat wall must be
